validation.fresh_index_export_scope: Separate root validation on the same macOS host, with a checkout path containing spaces, without local config or runtime snapshots. Its aggregate counts include other implementation lanes and are not additional runtime tests.

review.scope: Independent source inspection and 95 local/fixture tests; no deployment, native authentication or native enforcement acceptance.

final_delta_recheck.result: Reviewer inspected the final regex error wrapper and two final regressions, reran all 15 configuration tests, and confirmed all other reviewed runtime source hashes remained unchanged.

reviewed_fixes: The login callback and cleanup use the configured SSH alias; a mocked started-to-URL-to-authenticated flow verifies tunnel construction without a real login.
The synthetic shell wrapper preserves the selected baseline path while stripping credentials and Python module overrides.
A relative app path is normalized before deriving the anchored running-process guard; invalid regex syntax produces a fixed ValueError.
Cloud lifecycle and local rollback verify the exact loaded LaunchAgent program and SSH arguments before mutations; only exact absence permits bootstrap.
Pinned known-host paths retain final symlink visibility and reject symlinked files.
The reusable presenter suite uses generated receipts and explicit fixture configuration, preserving command, CSRF, output, schema and concurrency checks without historical deployment dependencies.
Fresh-machine documentation uses the prepared manifest workflow and lists required ARM artifacts, runtime staging and separate S3 fixture/digest prerequisites.

boundaries.private_config: config/demo.local.json contains the migrated deployment bindings without credentials, is mode 0600, is ignored, and is intentionally excluded from this receipt file inventory.
boundaries.root_timer_migration: Performed separately by root after this lane supplied and tested exact legacy migration support; see evidence/portability/client-telemetry-migration.json.
boundaries.linux_scope: Platform behavior is covered by local fixtures and explicit manual-mode paths; this receipt does not establish execution on a separate Linux client machine.
boundaries.arm_installation_scope: Installer parameters and guards were inspected and shell syntax checked. No ARM runtime installer was executed by this lane.
boundaries.historical_artifacts: Accepted presentation artifacts, HANDOFF.md, historical receipts and the legacy evidence-bound presenter test were preserved.
